notes: {"en":"Mixed system with 199 seats: 93 national list seats and 106 single-member district seats. Every seat is attributed here: list seats come from the minutes, district seats from the election office's composition page, and the two add up to 199. \"National list seats\" are the list tier only; \"whole-chamber seats\" add the district seats. Shares are computed here within each ballot. The election office's application prints shares over party-list and nationality-list votes together, so its figures differ. One nationality list reached the preferential quota and received one seat, leaving 92 seats for party lists. A joint list's votes and seats, including the district seats of candidates nominated by the same organisations, are not divided among its organisations.","zh-CN":"混合选制，共 199 席：93 个全国名单席位和 106 个单一选区席位。此处每个席位都已归属：名单席位来自会议记录，选区席位来自选举办公室的议会构成页面，两者合计 199 席。\"全国名单席位\"仅指名单层级；\"全议院席位\"另加选区席位。得票率在各选票内部计算。选举办公室的应用程序按政党名单票和民族名单票合计计算得票率，因此数字不同。一个民族名单达到优惠配额并获得一席，政党名单分配其余 92 席。联合名单的票数和席位（包括由相同组织共同提名的候选人赢得的选区席位）不分配给其各组织。"}
